notes: Quick notes from discovery: SMB edtech maker of classroom copilots for K-12 teachers.
Primary pain: need low-latency short-turn responses for teacher assistant + robust moderation to avoid student-facing hallucinations/unsafe outputs.
Budget: very price conscious; target ARR <$25k first year, looking for self-serve hosted to avoid ops overhead.
Prefers public cloud + Redwood hosted API to avoid infra ops — asked about regional data residency (US-only) and retention windows.
"I don't want to manage GPUs — we need something that works out of the box and can scale a few hundred concurrent sessions," said Ivy (CTO).
Moderation: wants built-in pre/post moderation hooks, custom blocklist, and confidence scores; will measure false positives vs false negatives closely.
Model preferences: open to small/medium open models (cost) but wants quality for conversational prompts; receptive to Redwood's routing/fallback recommendations.
Trial ask: short-term sandbox key with token cap + sample billing projection; example eval prompts to validate moderation and rubric for hallucination tolerance.
Security: SSO (SAML) for teacher admin console is required later; for now, wants SOC2-like assurances and audit log access.
Next asks enumerated: 1) technical scoping call 2) trial key + token projection 3) sample moderation thresholds + evaluation template 4) short terms sheet for SMB pricing.
